comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Taffy (5-knob). Red Panda Tensor-style live tape warp: reverse .. stop .. double speed with random slips. Speed is now the anchor the head always trends toward; Depth scales how far slips deviate from it; Glide sets tape-motor smoothness.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 0x01D2. Reverted from 482 to the last known-working id + safe default. (The 482 bump collided with stock effect fxids and broke on hardware; the audible-on-load Mix hack is obsolete now the editor materialises patches via a full-patch send.)

params.name: Speed
params.comment: params[5]. Tape-motor speed the head ALWAYS trends toward: 0=-1x reverse, 25=stop, 50=+1x normal, 100=+2x octave up.

params.name: Chance
params.comment: params[6]. How often random speed/direction slips happen.

params.name: Depth
params.comment: params[7]. How far a slip deviates from Speed (0 = slips do nothing, pure speed control; 100 = fully random tape warps).

params.name: Glide
params.comment: params[8]. Tape-motor smoothness: 0 = snappy/abrupt speed jumps, 100 = long smooth pitch glides.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Mix default 1 (quiet-safe). The editor materialises patches on load (full-patch send), so audible-on-load no longer needs a hot default.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
